entities.summary: Ivana Đerisilo-Stankovic is a volleyball player from Serbia, playing as an outside hitter. She was a member of the Women's National Team that won the bronze medal at the 2006 FIVB World Championship in Japan. She plays for the club CSM Târgoviște.
